headline: Sara Davies' Brand Crafter's Companion Enters Liquidation, Cutting 58 Jobs
summary: Newton Aycliffe-based craft brand Crafter's Companion, founded by Dragons' Den star Sara Davies, has gone into liquidation resulting in 58 redundancies, though the brand will continue trading under a deal with Gemporia.
why: Corporate liquidations and insolvencies highlight ongoing pressures on retail and manufacturing businesses, impacting regional employment.

impacts.name: Crafter's Companion
impacts.why: Liquidation forces business restructuring and job losses despite asset purchase agreements.
